name: XPRS 1.12.0-beta.2
body:
Beta: test it before 1.12.0 goes to the stable channel and F-Droid.

## Updates
- Updates find and download themselves in the background. XPRS checks every hour, keeps checking while the app is closed (on Android it rides the background service), and remembers a new version across restarts.
- A new Updates page: the card names the version that is coming ("Downloading XPRS 1.12.0-beta.2"), the installed version sits under it, the progress says where the bytes come from, and the release notes are drawn with their formatting.

## Archiver
- Change your station's callsign from the Archive tab or Settings > This device: roll a new one, go back to the previous one, save. A new callsign is a new station key; other stations learn it from the next announcements.

## Other
- The menu's exit item now reads Exit.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/xprs-dev/app/compare/v1.12.0-beta.1...v1.12.0-beta.2
